2. अव-ष्टभ्य mfn. to be seized or stopped, Kathās.

a: अवष्टंभ् — {c5c} {c9c} P. 1 To lean or rest upon; धनुरवष्टभ्य Mv. 5; so दंडं; प्रकृतिं स्वामवष्टभ्य Bg. 9. 8 by the help of; वृद्धां भार्यामवष्टभ्य Rām. on account of. --2 To block up; कोसलनृपतेर्द्वारमवष्टभ्य Ratn. 4. --3 To wrap, envelop, cover with; K. 116; तिमिरेणावष्टभ्यमाने जीवलोके 159; occupy; Dk. 159. --4 To support, prop, hold up; clasp, embrace; अवष्टभ्यासौ मां Mv. 5. 5; क्रोडविभागेन मामवष्टभ्य K. 33, 42, 54. --5 To hinder, stop, arrest, hold or keep back; अवष्टभ्यमान इव जलधरैः K. 303. --6 To be near --7 To be astounded or bewildered.

अवष्टंभः — [स्तंभ्-घञ्, सस्य षत्वं] 1 Leaning, resting upon. --2 Support, prop; पक्षाभ्यामीषत्कृतावष्टंभः K. 34, 44, 186, 231, 248; खडलतावष्टंभनिश्चलः Māl. 3; (hence) having recourse to, plucking up or summoning (as courage); तत्कथमहं धैर्यावष्टंभं करोमि Pt. 1; so पौरुष˚, धीरत्व˚ Māl. 2; सहजसत्त्व˚ K. 286. --3 Haughtiness, pride, dignity, majestic greatness; सावष्टंभाकृतिना K. 179 dignified, noble, see सावष्टंभ. --4 A post, pillar. --5 Gold. --6 Commencement, beginning. --7 Stopping, standing till, staying. --8 Courage, steadiness; K. 156, 157; resolute determination; ईदृशोऽस्यावष्टंभः Ratn. 4; अविनयकोपितोऽवष्टंभं कृत्वा K. 261 plucking up courage; पलायनमवष्टंभो वा Pt. 4 holding out (as opposed to पलायनं). --9 Obstruction, impediment. --10 Paralysis, stupefaction K. 141. --11 Excellence.

अवष्टंभमय — a. (यी f.) Golden, made of gold, or as large as a post; रघोरवष्टंभमयेन पत्रिणा R. 3. 53 (अ˚ is usually rendered in the above manner, but from the immediate context, it should more properly mean ‘full of dignified boldness’, ‘breathing defiance’).
अवष्टंभनं — 1 Resting upon, having recourse to. --2 Supporting. --3 Paralysing, stupefying. --4 A post, pillar. --5 Stopping, staying.

standing near, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 68; R. v, 56, 129

a: अवष्टब्ध — p. p. [अवस्तंभ्-क्त, षत्वम्] 1 Supported; rested on, protected; held, seized. --2 Hanging from or upon; अवष्टब्धा यष्टिः Sk. --3 Near, contiguous; अद्यश्वीनावष्टब्धे P. V. 2. 13, Bk. 9. 72. --4 Obstructed, stopped, suspended. --5 Paralysed. --6 Bound, tied, attached. --7 Wrapped up, enfolded. --8 Opposed. --9 Surpassed, overcome.

m: अव-ष्टब्धता f. stiffness, rigidity, Śaṃk.

अव-ष्टम्भ् (√ स्तम्भ्), -ष्टभ्नोति (&c., Pāṇ. viii, 3, 63 seqq.; generally ind.p. -ष्टभ्य, ĀśvŚr. &c.) to lean or rest upon, 3, 68, &c.; to bar, barricade, R. iii, 56, 7; -ष्टभ्नाति (Kathās.; Inf. -ष्टब्धुम्, ib.; Pass. aor. अवाष्टम्भि, Rājat.) to seize, arrest, R. v, 25, 52, &c.
